en: They are the results (vipāka) of wholesome and unwholesome phenomena belonging to the sense sphere, the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, and the unincluded (apariyāpanna); namely, the aggregate of feeling (vedanākkhandha).

The aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness, those phenomena which are functional (kiriyā) being neither wholesome nor unwholesome and not the result of kamma,
all form, and the unconditioned element—
